scope: Local-only reconciliation of seven evidence-bearing Batch 04 targets to frozen generated wall runs. Education Center Building 29B is excluded. This is geometry/provenance evidence, not a runtime edit or module authorization.

classification_vocabulary.full_observed_side: The recorded view establishes the complete direct primary facets of the named side; explicitly excluded notches/returns remain unmapped.
classification_vocabulary.partial_observed_side: The exact source-side chain is identified, but coverage, identity, distance or occlusion prevents a complete safe facade claim.
classification_vocabulary.material_only_safe: The exact receiving chain is high-confidence, but evidence supports only the stated homogeneous material/value field.
classification_vocabulary.unmapped: Observation-to-run ownership is not high-confidence, the face is unobserved, or a blocker is preserved.
